d385774d3552: For a T-shirt or hoodie, decide which measurements you need: chest width, garment length, sleeve length or shoulder width. Use a garment that already fits as your comparison and measure it in the same way. If your reference chest width is 54 cm laid flat and the seller's chart states 108 cm circumference, those values may describe the same nominal dimension, but only if the methods match. Do not compare 54 directly with 108 as though both were flat widths.
391a75810f55: A useful measurement photograph shows the whole relevant section, where the tape starts, where it ends and the numbers clearly enough to read. Fabric should lie naturally without unexplained stretching or folds. A curved tape, hidden zero point or angled camera can make an apparently precise number unreliable. Ask for a clearer method before treating a small difference as conclusive.
b8d176433b40: Record the observed value and any uncertainty separately. For example, “chest approximately 54 cm, tape start partly hidden” is more useful than “size correct.” Decide your acceptable measurement range before reviewing the result, based on your own garment and preferences. This guide does not supply one universal tolerance for every fabric or clothing type.
cb8589f9a13c: Adapt the check to shoes and accessories
1a9a775e1b83: For shoes, inspect both shoes, the visible size labels, sole pattern, left-right consistency and any obvious damage. If length information matters, specify what should be measured. The outside sole length does not equal internal usable length, and an insole may not be removable. Ask whether the requested method is available rather than instructing someone to damage or dismantle the item.
704a7196f8db: For bags, check overall dimensions, handles or straps, closures, visible seams and included accessories. For items with rigid parts, check obvious deformation and whether protection will be needed during shipping. These observations help with acceptance and packaging decisions, but a photograph cannot demonstrate load capacity or extended use.
c7d0a59a9f6d: Keep the seller's reference beside your item photos. Differences in camera angle and lighting can alter the appearance of colour and shape. 52fed4c09586: A soft clothing parcel with stable item records and no rigid packaging may not need another step if the live route and payable amount already satisfy your limits.
